independent_dc_superposition_bounds.method: Magnitude sum of independent linear error responses, plus baseline; eight resistor signs and two reference endpoints

finite_model_sensitivity.interpretation: Hypothetical two-pole FDA/current-output-resistance sensitivity only; not manufacturer macromodel, gain/phase margin or transient stability proof

settling_screen.limited_model: Two allocated dominant exponential terms; no saturated-startup, clock kickback, nonlinear cap or power-sequence proof

own_noise_screen.assumptions: Typical white+1/f voltage/current models; ideal nominal resistor matching; no pump/rail noise or aliasing; not measured SNR
excluded: ADC intrinsic/reference noise and EVM ADC driver overlap
Nonlinear ADC switching/aliasing, distortion and temperature

power_fault_screen.note: No manufacturer max startup/ripple/transient interpolation guarantee. Qualify actual current/ripple/overshoot, reference loading, clamps and partial power; no fabricated fail-safe claim.

e10_inherited_voltage_bound.interpretation: Ideal bounded BUF_OUT before passive output R; native E10 circuit sources unchanged; not physical overload/swing proof
